description: Record the owner’s own words as their creative rights declaration, only after their explicit confirmation (ownerConfirmed: true), with expectedVersion from soclo_rights_declaration_get (0 if absent) and a stable clientRequestId. Never invent, paraphrase or auto-confirm a declaration. A saved owner declaration covers lawful current and future account uploads across channels. It does not grant real-person likeness consent. New saves need no scope selection; an explicit legacy scope is sent unchanged only to reconcile its original request. Free; it does not approve a price, review an identifiable person, upload a photo, create an actor or generate anything. The returned operation is an immutable historical receipt; only current.declaration in active state supplies rightsProof. Keep the same ID and words when reconciling an uncertain save; do not automatically retry.
name: soclo_rights_declaration_save
title: Save your creative rights declaration
